remarks: If you're looking for wide open space than look no more. Seller has 2 adjacent parcels for sale. One is 4.96 acres and the other is 4.92 acres being sold separately at $34,900.00 each. Both are cleared open land on a hilltop with a view. Plenty of wildlife. There is an area on the back of each parcel that is wooded. Located on Glinderman Road in the peaceful town of Caneadea NY. There is access to electric power and telephone at the road. These parcels are approximately 1.7 miles to the 58-acre Allen Lake and access toto over 2,000 acres of sate forest. Genesee River access points and Sugar Mountain Festival grounds are also nearby. many possibilities await. Build your year-round home or seasonal cabin.
